name: tag-per-track
description: Agentic-first audio analysis and music tagging with x402 USDC micro-payments on Base.

private_key.title: Base Burner Wallet Private Key
private_key.description: 66-character hex private key starting with 0x (burner wallet funded with USDC on Base network)

max_spending_usdc.title: Max Spending Cap (USDC)
max_spending_usdc.description: Client-side safety limit in USDC per request (default: 0.20)

tools.name: analyze_audio
tools.description: Analyzes a music track or audio file to extract musical metadata (BPM, genre, mood, key, instruments) and optionally vocal lyrics with x402 USDC micro-payments on Base.

tools.name: analyze_audio_with_lyrics
tools.description: Analyzes an audio track to extract complete musical metadata AND transcribe full vocal lyrics using AI Whisper with x402 USDC micro-payments on Base.

tools.name: analyze_audio_batch
tools.description: Analyzes multiple music tracks or audio files in parallel (batch processing) with x402 USDC micro-payments on Base.

tools.name: lookup_artist_stats
tools.description: Retrieves streaming traction and commercial metrics for an artist (Spotify monthly listeners, followers, popularity score) for A&R qualification.

prompts.name: qualify_demo_ar
prompts.description: Comprehensive A&R demo evaluation for record labels combining Essentia acoustic analysis with real-time Spotify streaming traction.
prompts.text: Qualify the track at {{audio_source}} for record label A&R signing decision.

prompts.name: batch_demo_screening
prompts.description: Screens an EP, album, or folder of demo submissions in parallel, evaluating energy flow, harmonic key progression, and selecting standout lead singles.
prompts.text: Screen the batch of audio_sources in parallel.
